en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with rolling meadows, scattered trees, and a forested hill in the background. In the foreground stands a long traditional half‑timbered farmhouse or inn complex with a gabled roof and a veranda. The setting is quiet countryside. At the top of the postcard, printed in red German text, are the location and the name of the building.
